g.text: At 10% growth, LP IRR falls below the 15% model benchmark while GP carry remains positive.
Baseline model assumes no hurdle; TPG VI's exact preferred-return terms are not confirmed. 1.50% management fee.
GP receipts are PV at model inception, 15% assumed discount rate; TPG's co-investment and operating costs not modelled.
Source: Q3 Analysis!A34:E34, A36:E36, A38:E38; Case pp. 4–5. The 10% case is still a positive IRR, not a nominal LP loss; 15% is not a contractual hurdle.
The no-hurdle model returns capital and then splits profit regardless of the LP's rate of return.
